item.title: FedEx Sues for Refund of Trump Tariffs After Supreme Court Ruling
item.description: FedEx has filed a lawsuit in the U.S. Court of International Trade seeking a refund for emergency tariffs imposed by President Donald Trump after the U.S. Supreme Court ruled the levies illegal last week.

item.title: Explosion Near Moscow Train Station Kills Officer, Injures Two
item.description: An explosion near a train station in Moscow has left one police officer dead and two others injured, according to local authorities.
